_comment: The client programs enrolled with this hub, keyed by a uuid4 hex the panel assigns when a link is minted. The entry below is named with a leading underscore so it documents the shape without being read as a client. Written by the panel, never by hand: token_sha256 is the hash of the secret the program authenticates its channel with, the raw token exists only on that machine; hostname, platform and version are what the program last reported; ai_key_id names the gateway client key minted for it, revoked while it is disabled.
